component.name: Dockmoid
component.summary: Docker and Podman in your panel: live container status, crash alerts and one-click actions

description.p: Dockmoid keeps an eye on your containers from the Plasma panel. The logo shows overall state as a gauge, containers can be started, stopped, updated and inspected without a terminal, and it tells you when something crashes, turns unhealthy or stops answering.

ul.li: List, table and Compose-project views with search, pinning and sorting
Crash, unhealthy, restart-loop, resource and web-page alerts
Autostart control, image update checks and Compose up, down, pull and recreate
Images, volumes and networks with unused markers
Logs with filtering, graphs, remote Docker contexts and a detachable window
